grammar: Question: Is it + the same as + noun?
en: Is this the same as yours?
ipa: /ɪz ðɪs ðə seɪm æz jʊrz/
trPron: İz dis dı seym ez yurz
commonMistake: Is this the same like yours? ❌
aiExplain: The same her zaman "as" ile kullanılır. "Same like" yanlıştır.
imgQuery: two identical products side by side

grammar: Question: What + is + your + opinion + of + noun?
en: What is your opinion of the new policy?
ipa: /wʌt ɪz jʊr əˈpɪnjən əv ðə nuː ˈpɑləsi/
trPron: Vat iz yur ıpinyın ov dı nu palisi
commonMistake: What do you think of the new policy? ✔️ (daha yaygın)
aiExplain: What is your opinion of resmi bir yapıdır. "What do you think of" daha yaygındır.

grammar: Question: Why + is + it + that + clause?
en: Why is it that you are always late?
ipa: /waɪ ɪz ɪt ðæt juː ɑr ˈɔlweɪz leɪt/
trPron: Vay iz it det yu ar olveyz leyt
collocations: why is it that, always late
commonMistake: Why are you always late? ✔️ (daha basit)
aiExplain: Why is it that vurgulu bir soru kalıbıdır. "Why are you" daha basittir.
imgQuery: person looking at clock with angry expression

grammar: Question: Is it + likely + that + clause?
en: Is it likely that it will rain today?
ipa: /ɪz ɪt ˈlaɪkli ðæt ɪt wɪl reɪn təˈdeɪ/
trPron: İz it laykli det it vil reyn tudey
commonMistake: Is it likely it will rain today? ❌ (konuşmada geçer)
aiExplain: Resmi İngilizcede "that" kullanılır. "Is it likely it will rain" konuşma dilinde kabul edilir.

grammar: Question: Which + is + better + A or B?
en: Which is better, tea or coffee?
tr: Hangisi daha iyi, çay mı kahve mi?
ipa: /wɪʧ ɪz ˈbɛtər ti ɔr ˈkɔfi/
trPron: Viç iz beter ti or kofi
commonMistake: Which tea or coffee is better? ❌
aiExplain: Which tea or coffee is better? anlaşılır ama doğal değil. Doğrusu "Which is better, tea or coffee?"dir.
imgQuery: tea cup and coffee cup side by side

grammar: Question: How much + is + there + of + noun?
en: How much sugar is there in this recipe?
tr: Bu tarifte ne kadar şeker var?
ipa: /haʊ mʌʧ ˈʃʊgər ɪz ðɛr ɪn ðɪs ˈrɛsəpi/
trPron: Hav maç şugır iz der in dis resıpi
collocations: how much sugar, in this recipe
commonMistake: How many sugar is there? ❌
aiExplain: Sugar sayılamayan isim olduğu için "how much" kullanılır.

grammar: Question: Which way + is + it + to + place?
en: Which way is it to the city center?
ipa: /wɪʧ weɪ ɪz ɪt tu ðə ˈsɪti ˈsɛntər/
trPron: Viç vey iz it tu dı sİti sentır
collocations: which way is, to the city
commonMistake: Which way to the city center is it? ❌
aiExplain: Which way to the city center is it? yanlış sıralamadır.

grammar: Question: How long + is + it + going to be + until?
en: How long is it going to be until dinner?
ipa: /haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ɪt ˈgoʊɪŋ tu bi ənˈtɪl ˈdɪnər/
trPron: Hav long iz it goİng tu bi antil dinır
collocations: how long is, going to be
commonMistake: How long is it until dinner? ✔️ (daha basit)
aiExplain: How long is it going to be gelecek zaman. "How long is it until" daha basittir.

grammar: Question: Is it + still + adjective?
en: Is it still raining outside?
ipa: /ɪz ɪt stɪl ˈreɪnɪŋ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
trPron: İz it stil reynİng autsayd
commonMistake: Is it raining outside? ❌ (zaman referansı yok)
aiExplain: Still eylemin devam ettiğini belirtir. "Is it raining" sadece şu an yağıp yağmadığını sorar.

grammar: Question: Whose + responsibility + is it + to + verb?
en: Whose responsibility is it to lock the door?
ipa: /huz rɪˌspɑnsəˈbɪləti ɪz ɪt tu lɑk ðə dɔr/
trPron: Huz rispansıbılİti iz it tu lak dı dor
commonMistake: Who is responsible to lock the door? ✔️ (daha basit)
aiExplain: Whose responsibility is it resmi yapıdır. "Who is responsible" daha basittir.

grammar: Question: How come + is + it + that + clause?
en: How come it is that you speak Turkish so well?
tr: Nasıl oluyor da Türkçeyi bu kadar iyi konuşuyorsun?
ipa: /haʊ kʌm ɪt ɪz ðæt juː spik ˈtɜrkiʃ soʊ wɛl/
trPron: Hav kam it iz det yu spik Türkiş so vel
collocations: how come it is, speak Turkish
commonMistake: Why do you speak Turkish so well? ✔️ (daha basit)
aiExplain: How come "why" anlamında ama daha samimi bir yapıdır.

grammar: Question: Isn't it + adjective + that + clause?
en: Isn't it amazing that we are here?
ipa: /ˈɪzənt ɪt əˈmeɪzɪŋ ðæt wi ɑr hɪr/
trPron: İzınt it ımeyzİng det wi ar hir
commonMistake: Is it not amazing that we are here? ✔️ (daha resmi)
aiExplain: Negatif soru "isn't it" onay beklentisiyle kullanılır. "Is it not" daha resmidir.

grammar: Question: Would it be + okay + if + clause?
en: Would it be okay if I came a bit late?
tr: Biraz geç gelsem sorun olur mu?
ipa: /wʊd ɪt bi oʊˈkeɪ ɪf aɪ keɪm ə bɪt leɪt/
trPron: Vud it bi okey if ay keym ı bit leyt
collocations: would it be okay, if I came
commonMistake: Is it okay if I come late? ✔️ (daha basit)
aiExplain: Would it be okay if daha kibar bir yapıdır. "Is it okay if" daha basittir.

grammar: Question: How + adjective + is + it?
en: How difficult is the exam?
ipa: /haʊ ˈdɪfɪkəlt ɪz ði ɪgˈzæm/
trPron: Hav difikılt iz di igzam
commonMistake: How the exam is difficult? ❌
aiExplain: How difficult the exam is? yanlış sıralamadır.

grammar: Question: Isn't there + a/an + noun?
en: Isn't there a phone in this room?
ipa: /ˈɪzənt ðɛr ə foʊn ɪn ðɪs rum/
trPron: İzınt der ı fon in dis rum
collocations: isn't there a, in this room
commonMistake: Is there not a phone in this room? ✔️ (daha resmi)
aiExplain: Negatif soru "isn't there" şaşkınlık belirtir. "Is there not" daha resmidir.

grammar: Question: At what time + is + it + exactly?
en: At what time exactly is the meeting?
ipa: /æt wʌt taɪm ɪgˈzæktli ɪz ðə ˈmitɪŋ/
trPron: Et vat taym igzektli iz dı mitİng
collocations: at what time, is the meeting
commonMistake: What time exactly the meeting is? ❌
aiExplain: At what time resmi kullanımdır. "What time" daha yaygındır.
imgQuery: clock on wall with meeting room

grammar: Question: What if + it is + adjective?
en: What if it is too expensive?
ipa: /wʌt ɪf ɪt ɪz tuː ɪkˈspɛnsɪv/
trPron: Vat if it iz tu ikspensiv
collocations: what if it is, too expensive
commonMistake: What it is too expensive? ❌
aiExplain: What if yapısı varsayımsal bir durum sorar. "What it is" anlamlı değildir.
imgQuery: person looking at price tag with shock

grammar: Question: Is it + really + true + that + clause?
en: Is it really true that you are leaving?
ipa: /ɪz ɪt ˈrɪli tru ðæt juː ɑr ˈlivɪŋ/
trPron: İz it rili tru det yu ar livİng
collocations: is it really true, true that
commonMistake: Is it really true you are leaving? ❌ (konuşmada geçer)
aiExplain: Resmi İngilizcede "that" kullanılır. "Is it really true you are leaving" konuşma dilinde kabul edilir.

grammar: Question: How many + plural noun + are there + location?
en: How many students are there in the class?
ipa: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈstudənts ɑr ðɛr ɪn ðə klæs/
trPron: Hav meni studınts ar der in dı klas
commonMistake: How many students there are in the class? ❌
aiExplain: How many students there are yanlış sıralamadır.

grammar: Question: What + is + there + to be + worried about?
en: What is there to be worried about?
ipa: /wʌt ɪz ðɛr tu bi ˈwɜrid əˈbaʊt/
trPron: Vat iz der tu bi vörid abaut
commonMistake: What is there to be worried? ❌
aiExplain: Worried about kalıbında "about" şarttır.

grammar: Question: What + is + the address + of + place?
en: What is the address of the museum?
ipa: /wʌt ɪz ði ˈædrɛs əv ðə mjuˈziəm/
trPron: Vat iz di adres ov dı myuziım
collocations: what is the address, address of
commonMistake: What the address of the museum is? ❌
aiExplain: What the address of the museum is? yanlış sıralamadır.

grammar: Question: For what reason + is + it + that + clause?
en: for what reason, you are unhappy
ipa: cause, explanation
trPron: none
commonMistake: A1
aiExplain: be, question, reason

grammar: Question: Is there + any + possibility + that + clause?
en: Is there any possibility that he is wrong?
ipa: /ɪz ðɛr ˈɛni ˌpɑsəˈbɪləti ðæt hiː ɪz rɔŋ/
trPron: İz der eni pasıbılİti det hi iz rong
collocations: is there any possibility, that he is
commonMistake: Is there any possibility he is wrong? ❌
aiExplain: Resmi İngilizcede "that" kullanılır. Konuşma dilinde "that" atılabilir.

grammar: Question: Is + noun + better + than + noun?
en: Is your phone better than mine?
ipa: /ɪz jʊr foʊn ˈbɛtər ðæn maɪn/
trPron: İz yur fon beter den mayn
commonMistake: Is your phone better mine? ❌
aiExplain: Better karşılaştırma sıfatından sonra "than" gelir. "Better mine" yanlıştır.

grammar: Question: What + is + his/her + background?
en: What is her educational background?
ipa: /wʌt ɪz hɜr ˌɛʤʊˈkeɪʃənəl ˈbækgraʊnd/
trPron: Vat iz hır ecukeyşınıl bekgraund
commonMistake: What her educational background is? ❌
aiExplain: What her educational background is? yanlış sıralamadır.
